title: EXP-032 — Button Width Recovery Across Ordinary Close/Reopen
objective: On one new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_ButtonGeometryLab01`, place exactly one native Toolbox Button named `FX_ButtonGeometry01`, record its untouched Width, change only Width to exactly `180`, perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save to a demonstrably clean state, close the target Form exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control, then reopen it exactly once through the supported Designer Form-menu recent-forms path. Verify that the same User-scoped Form recovers the same Button with Name `FX_ButtonGeometry01` and Width exactly `180`, while the recorded comparison properties remain unchanged. Classify a successful first execution as observed UI-level component-geometry recovery only; do not claim Forms-database durability, cache eviction, or behavior of other geometry/component properties.

in_scope: Read the verified basic-Form and component recipes plus relevant EXP-027 ordinary Button recovery evidence before mutation
Use one new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form named `FX_ButtonGeometryLab01`
Place exactly one native Toolbox Button named `FX_ButtonGeometry01`
Record the Button's untouched Width and a small comparison-property baseline before the Width edit
Change only the Button Width to exactly `180` through the supported Designer property surface
Perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save and prove the Form returns clean
Verify Width=`180`, Name=`FX_ButtonGeometry01`, and comparison properties immediately after Save
Close only `FX_ButtonGeometryLab01` exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control
Reopen only `FX_ButtonGeometryLab01` exactly once through the supported Designer Form-menu recent-forms path
Verify exact User-scope identity and recovered Button Width after reopen
Capture decisive screenshots/accessibility/property observations before edit, after Save, after close, and after reopen
Write evidence only under `evidence/EXP-032/` and the EXP-032 experiment record
out_of_scope: EXP-031 Select Form retained-filter or refresh-semantics work
Button Caption, Button Type, Static Caption, Form Caption, Form Description, or Form-variable experiments
Height, Left, Top, position, anchoring, resizing by drag, responsive layout, or any geometry property other than Width
Bindings, IDOs, validators, events, scripts, expressions, runtime actions, or data access
Explicit global-Form-object unload or IDO-metadata-cache testing
Forms-database durability, cache-eviction, serialization-provenance, or cross-scope claims

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight proves a usable live Designer in User scope and proves `FX_ButtonGeometryLab01` is absent before mutation using a supported live inventory check with a known-present positive control; no session establishment occurs after mutation begins.

Exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_ButtonGeometryLab01` is created using the verified basic-Form procedure and is left open and clean, with screenshot/property evidence identifying Name, ScopeType, and ScopeName.
Exactly one native Toolbox Button `FX_ButtonGeometry01` exists on the target Form; evidence records its untouched Width and comparison-property baseline before the controlled Width edit.

Only Width is changed to exactly `180`; exactly one ordinary Designer Save succeeds; the Designer returns clean; post-Save evidence shows Name=`FX_ButtonGeometry01`, Width=`180`, and all recorded comparison properties unchanged.
The clean target Form is closed exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control, with no unsaved-change prompt or other Form lifecycle action; evidence proves the target is no longer open.
The target Form is reopened exactly once through the supported Designer Form-menu recent-forms path, with no direct URL navigation, reload, unload, second Save, or second close/reopen.

After reopen, decisive property evidence proves the loaded version is the same User-scoped `FX_ButtonGeometryLab01` and contains exactly the intended Button `FX_ButtonGeometry01` with Width exactly `180`; the recorded comparison properties remain equal to the pre-close post-Save baseline and the Designer is clean.

Final audit reconciles exactly one target Form creation, one Button placement, one Width edit, one ordinary Save, one target close, and one target reopen; repository changes are confined to the EXP-032 record plus `evidence/EXP-032/`; no unload, User Preference change, unrelated artifact mutation, or extra lifecycle action occurred. A passing result is classified observed only.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261007-200942-NcTj. Rationale: The next useful factory capability is component geometry persistence, which has not yet been isolated by the existing experiments. This does not depend on blocked EXP-031 and builds only on already established foundations: verified basic Form creation and component placement/configuration, plus prior evidence that a native Button component can survive an ordinary Save and close/reopen lifecycle. Testing one deterministic Width value is smaller and safer than adding another lifecycle boundary or another component metadata family.
